purpose: Bounded startup context for xq-harness. Load this first, then query one feature, topic, or module at a time.

startup.summaryRule: Use summary first. Do not preload broad docs or module trees.

topics.title: Repo overview
topics.summary: What xq-harness contains, the main package lines, and where code lives.
topics.when: Use when the task is repo-wide or the target area is still unknown.

topics.title: Module workflow
topics.summary: How to use modules.yaml and ./scripts/module without ad-hoc commands.
topics.when: Use before install/build/test work or when touching a specific module.

topics.title: Agent workflow
topics.summary: How agents should start, narrow context, update state, and close a session.
topics.when: Use when process, startup, or handoff behavior is relevant.

topics.title: Architecture and decision docs
topics.summary: Where architecture, product, and story docs live and when to open them.
topics.when: Use before making design decisions or changing public behavior.
